title: Nested List

illustrates.quote: All items within the section with subentries are treated as a nested list, even if some items do not have a subentry. (See Sample 8-10: Nested List on page 8-23.)

blocks.features: An introductory sentence and a closing sentence, each standing alone with no subentries of their own, bracketing four indented items (one of which wraps to a second print line).

items.text: Pay attention to the following features as you write your essay:
Control of sentence structure, punctuation, grammar, word choice, and spelling.
Your essay should be long enough to develop the topic adequately.

print.printFeatures: Plain nested list; introductory and closing sentences flush left, four indented items between them, no bullets/numbers.
